geography.method: Each commune (Paris, Lyon, Marseille: each arrondissement) is weighted by the share of its registered voters (inscrits) who voted in this district in the 1st round of the 2024 legislative election. Communes are converted to the INSEE COG 2026.

source.name: Ministère de l'Intérieur — Élections législatives 2024, résultats définitifs du 1er tour par bureau de vote

populationSource.name: INSEE — Populations de référence (population municipale), via l'API Melodi

source.name: SSMSI (Ministère de l'Intérieur) — Base statistique communale de la délinquance enregistrée par la police et la gendarmerie nationales

crime.method: count = Σ share × count over communes whose figures are published; rate = 1000 × count / Σ share × population (dwellings for burglary) of those communes; coverage = population behind that rate / district population; rateEstimated adds, for unpublished communes, the SSMSI average count of unpublished communes in the department. Paris, Lyon and Marseille are counted as whole cities (no arrondissement figures for these indicators).

theftFromPersons.fr: Vols sans violence contre des personnes

fraud.fr: Escroqueries et fraudes aux moyens de paiement

source.name: SSMSI (Ministère de l'Intérieur) — Base statistique communale de la délinquance enregistrée par la police et la gendarmerie nationales
INSEE — Recensement de la population, Population active et chômage (DS_RP_EMPLOI_LR_PRINC), via l'API Melodi

unemploymentCensus.definition: Census unemployment rate of people aged 15–64 (self-declared, census definition — differs from the ILO rate). Census 2023 = annual surveys 2021–2025.
unemploymentCensus.method: rate = 100 × Σ share × unemployed / Σ share × labour force (15–64)

unemploymentQuarterly.definition: INSEE localised unemployment rate (ILO definition, quarterly average, seasonally adjusted).

source.name: INSEE — Taux de chômage localisés par zone d'emploi (moyennes trimestrielles, CVS)

district.method: Σ (population share of the district in each employment zone × zone rate). INSEE does not publish this rate for districts.

source.name: INSEE — Taux de chômage localisés par département (BDM, série TAUX-CHOMAGE, CVS)
INSEE — Filosofi : niveau de vie médian et taux de pauvreté (DS_FILOSOFI_CC), via l'API Melodi

income.definition: Median standard of living (disposable income per consumption unit, € per year) and poverty rate (% of people below 60 % of the metropolitan median).
income.method: Population-weighted mean of commune values: Σ share × population × value / Σ share × population over communes with a value. A mean of medians is an approximation, not the district's true median (INSEE does not publish district figures).

stateTransfers.en: State transfers received (DGF and other State grants) — a receipt, not State spending

source.name: OFGL — Comptes consolidés des communes (budget principal + budgets annexes), source DGFiP

communes.method: per inhabitant = Σ share × amount / Σ share × population over communes with published accounts (principal + annex budgets, consolidated). Paris's accounts include its département functions.

source.name: OFGL — Comptes consolidés des ensembles intercommunaux (communes + groupement, flux croisés neutralisés)

intercommunal.method: Population-weighted mean of the per-inhabitant figures of the intercommunal sets the district's communes belong to. Each set = its communes + the groupement, flows between them removed (the best measure of the 'bloc communal').

stateSpending.reason: The State does not publish its spending broken down by commune, district or department (budget execution is published by mission and programme at national level). The only sub-national State money in open data is what it transfers to local authorities — see localSpending.*.stateTransfers (DGF and other grants, OFGL) — which is a local receipt, not State spending in the territory. No approximation is made.
